test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A hemispherical dome of a building needs to be painted. If the circumference of the base of the dome is 154 cm, then find the cost of painting it if the cost of painting is Rs. 4 per 100 cm² (use π = (22)/(7)).
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Base circumference = 2 × π × r = 154 cm

⇒ r = 154 ÷ (2 × 22 ÷ 7) = 24.5 cm

⇒ Curved Surface Area (CSA) of hemisphere = 2 × π × r² = Circumference × r

⇒ CSA = 154 × 24.5 = 3773 cm²

⇒ Total painting cost = (3773 ÷ 100) × 4 = 150.92

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 150.92.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Circumference of the dome base = 154 cm

Cost of painting = Rs. 4 per 100 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of base = 2 × π × r

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of hemisphere = 2 × π × r²

Total Cost = (CSA ÷ 100) × Rate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8216974f61a48255b14ad6f15cb1f3c9320654561086ad180e36c95cc06ea66.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × π × r = 154

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r = 154

⇒ r = (154 × 7) ÷ 44

⇒ r = 24.5 cm

⇒ Area to be painted (CSA) = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 24.5 × 24.5

⇒ CSA = (44 ÷ 7) × 600.25

⇒ CSA = 44 × 85.75 = 3773 cm²

⇒ Total Cost = (3773 ÷ 100) × 4

⇒ Total Cost = 37.73 × 4 = 150.92

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 150.92.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Hemisphere

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the flat circular base. Formula: TSA = 3 × π × r².

Volume of a Hemisphere

It represents the capacity or space occupied by the hemisphere. Formula: Volume = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Surface Area of a Full Sphere

The total curved surface of a complete sphere is double the CSA of a hemisphere. Formula: Surface Area = 4 × π × r².
